3.measure_note: legacy_colAB Schedule A is an UNDERLINE form, not a boxed grid: rowbands.py returns 17 per-column underline rules (fill 0.95, 4 segments each) at a fitted pitch of 4.0500 explaining 17/17 with mean residual 0.0097, and the four segments ARE the column bands (Date 4.9-16.7, Name 18.3-52.1, Address 53.7-81.7, Amount 83.1-93.3). THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N]; row 1 has no rule above it and its band is extrapolated one pitch up from the first detected rule at 20.07. TWO-CROP PROOF at 500 dpi: the row-1 box pct:83.1,16.02,10.2,4.05@p3 rendered '745.00' (recorded 745.00) and the row-4 box pct:83.1,28.21,10.2,4.04@p3 rendered '180.75' beside 'Greg Graves' and the date '10.17.14' (recorded 180.75). A control crop of the row-2 band rendered '300.00', confirming the bands are not off by one.
